info.title: Eatsights API
info.description: Open food data (CC0-1.0). The JSON Schema files at /schema/v0.3/ are the contract; observation values are validated against the registry's value_schema at runtime.

get.summary: Search places by geohash cell, a quantised circle, city, category or name.

parameters.name: cell
parameters.description: Geohash cell (1-9 characters). Preferred: shared, cacheable URLs.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Metres, default 1000, max 2000; rounded up to 100 m.
